messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?

Sorry, I can’t share information about other customers or their returns. I can confirm your order shows the garden hose reel was received back and hasn’t been refunded yet. Would you like me to start a refund request for it?
Yes, please start the refund request. Could you share your neighbour’s name or email so I can ask her how her return went?
